claims: No. 3-seeded Duke defeated 14th-seeded Charleston 81-64 on Friday, March 20, 2026.
The game was in the first round of the Women's NCAA Tournament.
The game was at Cameron Indoor Stadium in Durham, N.C.
Toby Fournier scored 24 points for Duke.
Taryn Barbot scored 36 points for Charleston.
Delaney Thomas scored 19 points for Duke.
Jordan Wood scored 17 points for Duke.
Taylor Barbot scored 13 points for Charleston.
Duke had a 44-20 advantage in paint points.
Duke led by as many as 28 points.
Duke is appearing in their fourth straight NCAA tournament.
Toby Fournier shot 11-of-18 from the field for Duke.
Jordan Wood shot 5-of-5 from 3-point range for Duke.
Charleston made their first-ever NCAA tournament appearance.
Taryn Barbot's 36 points was the highest individual score against Duke this season.
Duke advances to face No. 6-seed Baylor in the second round.
Duke will face No. 6-seed Baylor on Sunday, March 22, 2026, in Durham, NC.
